Definition: perhaps from the same as G5205 (as being transparent like rain); glass:--glass.
BiblicalUsage: hýalos means glass, crystal. In Revelation 21:18, the text says "like unto clear glass."
TheologicalSignificance: In hýalos I find no hidden theology; it simply means glass, crystal.
